83:7.text: (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, evil-doers and the wicked)

83:8.text: And what will make you know what Sijjîn is?

83:10.text: Woe, that Day, to those who deny.

83:11.text: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.

83:12.text: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds,
(in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allâh)

83:13.text: are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"

83:14.text: Nay! But on their hearts is the Rân

83:15.text: will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.

83:16.text: Then, verily, they will indeed enter

83:17.text: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"

83:19.text: And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyûn is?

83:21.text: To which bear witness those nearest

83:24.text: You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.

83:25.text: They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine.

83:26.text: will be the smell of Musk, and for this let
those strive who want to strive
(i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah)

83:28.text: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allâh.

83:29.text: those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

83:30.text: And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another

83:31.text: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

83:32.text: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily these have indeed gone astray!"

83:33.text: had not been sent as watchers over them

83:34.text: those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers
